text: The built set is now read from the status table by column: the id comes from cell 1 and the verdict from cell 2. Scraping ids from the whole row let cross-references leak in — PAWL-024 and PAWL-027 both say 'extends PAWL-013', which put PAWL-013 in the built set although its own row reads 'drafted, not built', so its 13 promises were counted as due. Matching the literal **built** also missed PAWL-011, whose row reads **AC1-AC6, AC9 built**, hiding 9. The reported debt was wrong in both directions: 164 should have been 160.
